index.name: collection_id
index.description: short string with the identifier of the collection the series belongs to

index.name: analysis_result_id
index.description: this string is not empty if the specific series is part of an analysis results collection; analysis results can be added to a given collection over time

index.name: PatientID
index.description: identifier of the patient within the collection (DICOM attribute)

index.name: StudyInstanceUID
index.description: unique identifier of the DICOM study (DICOM attribute)

index.name: source_DOI
index.description: Digital Object Identifier of the dataset that contains the given series; follow this DOI to learn more about the activity that produced this series

index.name: PatientAge
index.description: age of the subject at the time of imaging (DICOM attribute)

index.name: PatientSex
index.description: subject sex (DICOM attribute)

index.name: StudyDate
index.description: date of the study (de-identified) (DICOM attribute)

index.name: StudyDescription
index.description: textual description of the study content (DICOM attribute)

index.name: BodyPartExamined
index.description: body part imaged (not applicable for SM series) (DICOM attribute)

index.name: Modality
index.description: acquisition modality (DICOM attribute)

index.name: SOPClassUID
index.description: SOP Class UID identifying the type of DICOM object (e.g., CT Image Storage, Segmentation Storage); more specific than Modality for distinguishing object types (DICOM attribute)

index.name: sop_class_name
index.description: human-readable name of the SOP Class (e.g., "CT Image Storage", "Segmentation Storage"); derived from SOPClassUID

index.name: TransferSyntaxUID
index.description: Transfer Syntax UID identifying the encoding of the stored instances (e.g., Explicit VR Little Endian, JPEG 2000, HTJ2K); comma-separated when a series contains instances with different encodings, which is common for SM (DICOM attribute)

index.name: transfer_syntax_name
index.description: human-readable name of the Transfer Syntax (e.g., "JPEG 2000", "Explicit VR Little Endian"); comma-separated when a series contains instances with different encodings; derived from TransferSyntaxUID

index.name: Manufacturer
index.description: manufacturer of the equipment that produced the series (DICOM attribute)

index.name: ManufacturerModelName
index.description: model name of the equipment that produced the series (DICOM attribute)

index.name: SeriesDate
index.description: date of the series (de-identified) (DICOM attribute)

index.name: SeriesDescription
index.description: textual description of the series content (DICOM attribute)

index.name: SeriesNumber
index.description: series number (DICOM attribute)

index.name: instanceCount
index.description: number of instances in the series

index.name: license_short_name
index.description: short name of the license that applies to this series

index.name: series_init_idc_version
index.description: IDC data release version number when this series first appeared in IDC (integer, e.g., 1 for v1)

index.name: series_revised_idc_version
index.description: IDC data release version number when this series was most recently revised in IDC (integer, e.g., 24 for v24)

index.name: aws_bucket
index.description: name of the AWS S3 bucket that contains the series

index.name: crdc_series_uuid
index.description: unique identifier of the series within the IDC

index.name: series_aws_url
index.description: public AWS S3 URL to download the series in bulk (each instance is a separate file)

index.name: series_size_MB
index.description: total size of the series in megabytes

ct_index.name: SeriesInstanceUID
ct_index.description: DICOM SeriesInstanceUID — unique identifier of the CT series; use to join with idc_index

ct_index.name: ImageType
ct_index.description: image type values as defined in DICOM ImageType attribute (e.g., ORIGINAL/DERIVED, PRIMARY/SECONDARY, AXIAL/LOCALIZER); aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: PixelSpacing_row_mm
ct_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the row direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[0]; a subset of CT series have anisotropic spacing where this differs from PixelSpacing_col_mm; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: PixelSpacing_col_mm
ct_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the column direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[1]; a subset of CT series have anisotropic spacing where this differs from PixelSpacing_row_mm; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: SliceThickness
ct_index.description: nominal reconstructed slice thickness in mm as defined in DICOM SliceThickness attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: KVP
ct_index.description: peak kilovoltage of the X-ray tube in kV as defined in DICOM KVP attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

ct_index.name: ScanOptions
ct_index.description: acquisition scan options as defined in DICOM ScanOptions attribute (e.g., HELICAL MODE, AXIAL MODE, SCOUT MODE); may contain multiple values; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: ConvolutionKernel
ct_index.description: reconstruction convolution kernel as defined in DICOM ConvolutionKernel attribute; vendor-specific string (e.g., B30f, STANDARD, LUNG); may contain multiple values; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: GantryDetectorTilt
ct_index.description: nominal angle of the scanning gantry in degrees as defined in DICOM GantryDetectorTilt attribute; non-zero for gantry-tilted acquisitions; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

ct_index.name: XRayTubeCurrent_min
ct_index.description: minimum X-ray tube current in mA across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM XRayTubeCurrent attribute; equals XRayTubeCurrent_max for fixed-current acquisitions; lower than XRayTubeCurrent_max for dose-modulated acquisitions (MIN across all instances)

ct_index.name: XRayTubeCurrent_max
ct_index.description: maximum X-ray tube current in mA across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM XRayTubeCurrent attribute; equals XRayTubeCurrent_min for fixed-current acquisitions; higher than XRayTubeCurrent_min for dose-modulated acquisitions (MAX across all instances)

ct_index.name: FilterType
ct_index.description: type of filter used in the acquisition as defined in DICOM FilterType attribute (e.g., WEDGE, BUTTERFLY, FLAT); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

ct_index.name: Exposure_min
ct_index.description: minimum exposure in mAs across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM Exposure attribute; equals Exposure_max for fixed-exposure acquisitions; lower than Exposure_max for dose-modulated acquisitions (MIN across all instances)

ct_index.name: Exposure_max
ct_index.description: maximum exposure in mAs across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM Exposure attribute; equals Exposure_min for fixed-exposure acquisitions; higher than Exposure_min for dose-modulated acquisitions (MAX across all instances)

ct_index.name: ExposureTime_min
ct_index.description: minimum duration of the X-ray exposure in ms across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM ExposureTime attribute (MIN across all instances)

ct_index.name: ExposureTime_max
ct_index.description: maximum duration of the X-ray exposure in ms across all instances in the series, derived from DICOM ExposureTime attribute (MAX across all instances)

ct_index.name: DataCollectionDiameter
ct_index.description: diameter of the region over which data were collected in mm as defined in DICOM DataCollectionDiameter attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

ct_index.name: ReconstructionDiameter
ct_index.description: diameter of the reconstruction field of view in mm as defined in DICOM ReconstructionDiameter attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

ct_index.name: SpiralPitchFactor
ct_index.description: ratio of the beam pitch for helical CT as defined in DICOM SpiralPitchFactor attribute; NULL for non-helical (sequential/axial) acquisitions; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: SeriesInstanceUID
mr_index.description: DICOM SeriesInstanceUID — unique identifier of the MR series; use to join with idc_index

mr_index.name: MagneticFieldStrength
mr_index.description: static magnetic field strength in Tesla as defined in DICOM MagneticFieldStrength attribute; constant across instances within a series — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: ScanningSequence
mr_index.description: pulse sequence type as defined in DICOM ScanningSequence attribute (SE = Spin Echo, GR = Gradient Recalled, IR = Inversion Recovery, EP = Echo Planar); may contain multiple values; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: SequenceVariant
mr_index.description: variant of the scanning sequence as defined in DICOM SequenceVariant attribute (SK = Segmented k-Space, MTC = Magnetization Transfer Contrast, SS = Steady State, TRSS = Time Reversed Steady State, SP = Spoiled, MP = MAG Prepared, OSP = Oversampling Phase, NONE = No sequence variant); may contain multiple values; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: MRAcquisitionType
mr_index.description: whether the acquisition is 2D or 3D as defined in DICOM MRAcquisitionType attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: EchoTime
mr_index.description: distinct echo times in ms present in the series, derived from DICOM EchoTime attribute; aggregated as ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT) across all instances because EchoTime legitimately varies in multi-echo sequences; single-element array for single-echo series, multi-element array for multi-echo series (e.g., [2.46, 4.92, 7.38])

mr_index.name: RepetitionTime
mr_index.description: repetition time in ms as defined in DICOM RepetitionTime attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: EchoTrainLength
mr_index.description: number of echoes in the echo train as defined in DICOM EchoTrainLength attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: FlipAngle
mr_index.description: flip angle in degrees as defined in DICOM FlipAngle attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: PixelBandwidth
mr_index.description: receiver bandwidth per pixel in Hz as defined in DICOM PixelBandwidth attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: ImagingFrequency
mr_index.description: Larmor resonance frequency in MHz as defined in DICOM ImagingFrequency attribute; proportional to MagneticFieldStrength (42.577 MHz/T for proton); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: ImagedNucleus
mr_index.description: nucleus used for imaging as defined in DICOM ImagedNucleus attribute (e.g., 1H for proton, 31P, 23Na); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: PixelSpacing_row_mm
mr_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the row direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[0]; MR pixel spacing is isotropic in almost all series in IDC; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: PixelSpacing_col_mm
mr_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the column direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[1]; MR pixel spacing is isotropic in almost all series in IDC; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: SliceThickness
mr_index.description: nominal slice thickness in mm as defined in DICOM SliceThickness attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: InversionTime
mr_index.description: inversion time in ms as defined in DICOM InversionTime attribute; populated only for inversion recovery sequences, NULL otherwise; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

mr_index.name: ReceiveCoilName
mr_index.description: name of the receiver coil used as defined in DICOM ReceiveCoilName attribute; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: SequenceName
mr_index.description: manufacturer-specific pulse sequence name as defined in DICOM SequenceName attribute (e.g., *tfl* for Siemens FLASH, *ep_b1000* for Siemens EPI diffusion); aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

mr_index.name: DiffusionBValue
mr_index.description: distinct diffusion b-values in s/mm² present in the series, derived from DICOM DiffusionBValue attribute; aggregated as ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT) across all instances because DiffusionBValue legitimately varies across instances in diffusion-weighted series; empty array for non-DWI series; multi-element for DWI (e.g., [0.0, 1000.0])

mr_index.name: NumberOfTemporalPositions
mr_index.description: number of temporal positions (time frames) in the series as defined in DICOM NumberOfTemporalPositions attribute; populated for dynamic (DCE-MRI) series; NULL otherwise; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: SeriesInstanceUID
pt_index.description: DICOM SeriesInstanceUID — unique identifier of the PET series; use to join with idc_index

pt_index.name: SeriesType
pt_index.description: acquisition type of the series as defined in DICOM SeriesType attribute, encoded as a slash-separated string of the two type values (e.g., STATIC/IMAGE, DYNAMIC/IMAGE, GATED/IMAGE, WHOLE BODY/IMAGE); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE(ARRAY_TO_STRING(SeriesType, '/'))

pt_index.name: Units
pt_index.description: pixel value units as defined in DICOM Units attribute (e.g., BQML = Bq/mL, CNTS = counts, CPS = counts/s, GML = g/mL); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: DecayCorrection
pt_index.description: type of decay correction applied as defined in DICOM DecayCorrection attribute (START = corrected to scan start time, ADMIN = corrected to radiopharmaceutical administration time, NONE = no correction); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: CorrectedImage
pt_index.description: list of corrections applied to the image as defined in DICOM CorrectedImage attribute (e.g., ATTN = attenuation, SCAT = scatter, DECY = decay, RAN = randoms); may contain multiple values; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: RandomsCorrectionMethod
pt_index.description: method used for randoms correction as defined in DICOM RandomsCorrectionMethod attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: ReconstructionMethod
pt_index.description: reconstruction algorithm as defined in DICOM ReconstructionMethod attribute (e.g., OSEM, FBP); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: ActualFrameDuration
pt_index.description: distinct actual frame durations in ms present in the series, derived from DICOM ActualFrameDuration attribute; aggregated as ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT) across all instances because ActualFrameDuration legitimately varies across frames in dynamic PET acquisitions; single-element array for static PET, multi-element for dynamic PET with variable frame durations

pt_index.name: ScatterCorrectionMethod
pt_index.description: scatter correction method as defined in DICOM ScatterCorrectionMethod attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: AttenuationCorrectionMethod
pt_index.description: attenuation correction method as defined in DICOM AttenuationCorrectionMethod attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: RadionuclideCodeMeaning
pt_index.description: code meaning of the radionuclide used, from RadiopharmaceuticalInformationSequence[0].RadionuclideCodeSequence[0].CodeMeaning; (e.g., Fluorine F18, Gallium Ga-68); constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: RadionuclideTotalDose
pt_index.description: total administered dose of the radionuclide in Bq, from RadiopharmaceuticalInformationSequence[0].RadionuclideTotalDose; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: RadiopharmaceuticalStartTime
pt_index.description: time of radiopharmaceutical administration (injection time), from RadiopharmaceuticalInformationSequence[0].RadiopharmaceuticalStartTime; stored as STRING (HH:MM:SS.FFFFFF) because DICOM TIME type is not supported in parquet output; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: Radiopharmaceutical
pt_index.description: free-text name of the radiopharmaceutical as defined in RadiopharmaceuticalInformationSequence[0].Radiopharmaceutical (e.g., Fluorodeoxyglucose F^18^); values are not standardized across sites; see RadionuclideCodeMeaning for a more consistent alternative; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: PixelSpacing_row_mm
pt_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the row direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[0]; PET pixel spacing is isotropic in almost all series in IDC; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

pt_index.name: PixelSpacing_col_mm
pt_index.description: in-plane pixel spacing along the column direction in mm, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing[1]; PET pixel spacing is isotropic in almost all series in IDC; aggregated with ANY_VALUE — constant across instances within a series

pt_index.name: SliceThickness
pt_index.description: nominal slice thickness in mm as defined in DICOM SliceThickness attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: NumberOfSlices
pt_index.description: total number of slices in the series as defined in DICOM NumberOfSlices attribute; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

pt_index.name: NumberOfTimeSlices
pt_index.description: number of time frames in the series as defined in DICOM NumberOfTimeSlices attribute; populated only for dynamic (multi-frame) PET series, NULL for static PET; constant across instances — aggregated with ANY_VALUE

sm_index.name: ContainerIdentifier
sm_index.description: identifier of the container (e.g., glass slide) holding the specimen from DICOM ContainerIdentifier attribute

sm_index.name: embeddingMedium_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: embedding medium CodeMeaning from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: embeddingMedium_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: embedding medium code tuple from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: tissueFixative_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: tissue fixative CodeMeaning from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: tissueFixative_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: tissue fixative code tuple from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: staining_usingSubstance_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: staining substances CodeMeaning from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: staining_usingSubstance_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: staining substances code tuple from DICOM SpecimenPreparationSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: min_PixelSpacing_2sf
sm_index.description: pixel spacing in mm at the maximum resolution layer, rounded to 2 significant figures, derived from DICOM PixelSpacing attribute

sm_index.name: max_TotalPixelMatrixColumns
sm_index.description: width of the image at the maximum resolution from DICOM TotalPixelMatrixColumns attribute

sm_index.name: max_TotalPixelMatrixRows
sm_index.description: height of the image at the maximum resolution from DICOM TotalPixelMatrixRows attribute

sm_index.name: ObjectiveLensPower
sm_index.description: power of the objective lens from DICOM ObjectiveLensPower attribute in OpticalPathSequence

sm_index.name: primaryAnatomicStructure_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: anatomic location code tuple from DICOM PrimaryAnatomicStructureSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: primaryAnatomicStructure_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: anatomic location CodeMeaning from DICOM PrimaryAnatomicStructureSequence in SpecimenDescriptionSequence

sm_index.name: primaryAnatomicStructureModifier_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: specimen modifier code tuple from DICOM PrimaryAnatomicStructureModifierSequence (when available)

sm_index.name: primaryAnatomicStructureModifier_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: specimen modifier CodeMeaning from DICOM PrimaryAnatomicStructureModifierSequence (when available)

sm_index.name: illuminationType_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: illumination type code tuple from DICOM IlluminationTypeCodeSequence in OpticalPathSequence

sm_index.name: illuminationType_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: illumination type CodeMeaning from DICOM IlluminationTypeCodeSequence in OpticalPathSequence

sm_index.name: admittingDiagnosis_code_designator_value_str
sm_index.description: admitting diagnosis code tuple from DICOM AdmittingDiagnosesCodeSequence (when available)

sm_index.name: admittingDiagnosis_CodeMeaning
sm_index.description: admitting diagnosis CodeMeaning from DICOM AdmittingDiagnosesCodeSequence (when available)

sm_instance_index.name: embeddingMedium_CodeMeaning
sm_instance_index.description: embedding medium used for the slide preparation

sm_instance_index.name: tissueFixative_CodeMeaning
sm_instance_index.description: tissue fixative used for the slide preparation

sm_instance_index.name: staining_usingSubstance_CodeMeaning
sm_instance_index.description: staining substances used for the slide preparation

sm_instance_index.name: PixelSpacing_0
sm_instance_index.description: pixel spacing in mm, rounded to 2 significant figures

sm_instance_index.name: instance_size
sm_instance_index.description: size of the instance file in bytes

sm_instance_index.name: TotalPixelMatrixColumns
sm_instance_index.description: number of columns in the image

sm_instance_index.name: TotalPixelMatrixRows
sm_instance_index.description: number of rows in the image

sm_instance_index.name: crdc_instance_uuid
sm_instance_index.description: unique identifier of the instance within the IDC

contrast_index.name: SeriesInstanceUID
contrast_index.description: DICOM SeriesInstanceUID identifier of the imaging series

contrast_index.name: ContrastBolusAgent
contrast_index.description: distinct contrast agent names used in the series as defined in DICOM ContrastBolusAgent attribute

contrast_index.name: ContrastBolusIngredient
contrast_index.description: distinct contrast agent ingredients used in the series as defined in DICOM ContrastBolusIngredient attribute

contrast_index.name: ContrastBolusRoute
contrast_index.description: distinct contrast administration routes used in the series as defined in DICOM ContrastBolusRoute attribute

seg_index.name: SeriesInstanceUID
seg_index.description: DICOM SeriesInstanceUID identifier of the segmentation series

seg_index.name: SegmentationType
seg_index.description: Type of segmentation as defined in DICOM SegmentationType attribute

seg_index.name: total_segments
seg_index.description: Number of segments in the segmentation series obtained by counting distinct DICOM SegmentNumber values in the DICOM SegmentatationSequence

seg_index.name: AlgorithmType
seg_index.description: Segmentation algorithm type as available in DICOM SegmentAlgorithmType

seg_index.name: AlgorithmName
seg_index.description: Segmentation algorithm name as available in DICOM SegmentAlgorithmName

seg_index.name: segmented_SeriesInstanceUID
seg_index.description: SeriesInstanceUID of the referenced image series that the segmentation applies to

seg_index.name: SegmentedPropertyCategory_CodeMeanings
seg_index.description: Array of distinct CodeMeaning values from SegmentedPropertyCategoryCodeSequence across all segments in the series, representing the broad category of the segmented property as defined in DICOM PS3.3 C.8.20.2, e.g., ["Anatomical Structure"], ["Morphologically Altered Structure"]

seg_index.name: SegmentedPropertyType_CodeMeanings
seg_index.description: Array of distinct CodeMeaning values from SegmentedPropertyTypeCodeSequence across all segments in the series, representing the specific type of the segmented property as defined in DICOM PS3.3 C.8.20.2, e.g., ["Liver", "Kidney", "Spleen"]

seg_index.name: AnatomicRegion_CodeMeanings
seg_index.description: Array of distinct CodeMeaning values from AnatomicRegionSequence across all segments in the series, representing the anatomic location of the segmented structure as defined in DICOM PS3.3 C.8.20.2, e.g., ["Abdomen"], ["Thorax", "Head"]

ann_group_index.name: AnnotationPropertyCategory_code
ann_group_index.description: annotation property category code tuple (CodingSchemeDesignator:CodeValue) from DICOM AnnotationPropertyCategoryCodeSequence

ann_group_index.name: AnnotationPropertyCategory_CodeMeaning
ann_group_index.description: human-readable meaning of the annotation property category from DICOM AnnotationPropertyCategoryCodeSequence

ann_group_index.name: AnnotationPropertyType_code
ann_group_index.description: annotation property type code tuple (CodingSchemeDesignator:CodeValue) from DICOM AnnotationPropertyTypeCodeSequence

ann_group_index.name: AnnotationPropertyType_CodeMeaning
ann_group_index.description: human-readable meaning of the annotation property type from DICOM AnnotationPropertyTypeCodeSequence

ann_group_index.name: AlgorithmName
ann_group_index.description: name of the algorithm from DICOM AlgorithmName attribute in AnnotationGroupAlgorithmIdentificationSequence (when AnnotationGroupGenerationType is AUTOMATIC)
